items.markdown:
![What is a Prenup? 5 Important Things to Know | KMJ Solicitors](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/11152235-2247-0139-0000-f1398b923457:6)
A **prenuptial agreement** (known in Australia as a **Binding Financial Agreement** or BFA) is `a written contract made before marriage or a de facto relationship that sets out how property, debts, superannuation, and spousal maintenance will be handled if the relationship ends`.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXfdGQhl1FCtDDAGAapZ1HEK89-ey6Ln6jMCTMxnjE4xKLGGtKpHFRBwvm76PxlezugtAcQ_F30UGCM0yY8brsJYeS7WnOCe3tjwGOrokaRL6uAhNl6QVbzRR4wPA4avsHaJysUZL32fpH)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXVFLXeM-0G70U4XUC1JVxim7ADTWqjAZOM3q2XYnkaBgd6d6JD2X0Lhfoh7LZRSVCsLrY6JOzT4dLFfRzHRuM5cYdguv69hkrKqXNyWujpABojl1K9CgxMid5APcQaiov72ynjmH4EmeTUe8yydTpLsmDgA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF1wKqg0e5FCebbs_YwgV-KqbwQwrMT9VVjOa8skm2VqEbxts9FxDEpOmCrUFAbCgs-MdOxThLnCCpajS5Wc0eQ8kXnfO_O71SxnPradnmxhXFh1uOooNSjEnQcf7YlfCBG1FCoSGjX0He3jJ8q8YVGmkNH4PSQgytstMAfyFk_NqSzLVUzZ3UAG6dZUsNGMYmAAAlZG-_T75FlJ8Nbw)

### What a Prenup Covers in Australia

- **Pre-existing assets:** Homes, investment properties, land, and vehicle equity.
- **Business interests:** Companies, sole-trader businesses, trusts, shares, and intellectual property.
- **Inheritances:** Family money, property, or future windfalls kept separate from the relationship pool.
- **Superannuation:** How retirement funds are split or retained individually.
- **Debts and liabilities:** Clarifying who is responsible for specific loans or credit balances.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXX8Dcvnrzkzi3I8h0rBOATpTk5nEgxQFqjvBiBrBQ25FTElitt1t2G_SVWjWbWPMDnVNunLIKuj1qOX8E2LpGzbCmuI5v_NmcKLJA6Rs2rIai5lTnBzX9W7u0mXA3PMOSCZ79bcvvz_f5EoJaC1Ltf1sNZnLMVfA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrQEBxCJF1yj-7_5O5LvZ8KxlQJEEKO9aVjSGx7nnh6UiqEzFqef2eaLvVF815Kj92aU4HVVHzcQyOwWWWr8qrKJAFxHuIHRRFLcnehvcQ9182Se4Wx05sqMqvjsVUbmFSyVoYihV48sOSo8k4mEJB4MxLapSFBEf24T0sk52pcqGeS6Oh5LIIwyjBfkShqO1KFjztDhn1pgxD6hUYB2cEdrqvhLeksoQjkaaZbZL1g)

### What a Prenup Cannot Cover

- **Child custody and parenting:** Courts decide care arrangements strictly based on the *best interests of the child*.
- **Child support:** Assessments must go through official government channels (such as the Child Support Agency) rather than a private contract.
- **Lifestyle or personal clauses:** Non-binding rules about behavior, household chores, or weight maintenance are legally unenforceable.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXfdGQhl1FCtDDAGAapZ1HEK89-ey6Ln6jMCTMxnjE4xKLGGtKpHFRBwvm76PxlezugtAcQ_F30UGCM0yY8brsJYeS7WnOCe3tjwGOrokaRL6uAhNl6QVbzRR4wPA4avsHaJysUZL32fpH)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXX8Dcvnrzkzi3I8h0rBOATpTk5nEgxQFqjvBiBrBQ25FTElitt1t2G_SVWjWbWPMDnVNunLIKuj1qOX8E2LpGzbCmuI5v_NmcKLJA6Rs2rIai5lTnBzX9W7u0mXA3PMOSCZ79bcvvz_f5EoJaC1Ltf1sNZnLMVfA)



---

### Legal Requirements for a Valid Australian BFA
For a prenuptial agreement to hold up in an Australian court under the *Family Law Act 1975* , it must meet strict criteria:

- **Independent legal advice:** Both partners must receive separate, independent legal advice from distinct Australian-admitted lawyers.
- **Signed legal certificates:** Each lawyer must sign a certificate attached to the agreement confirming they explained the legal pros and cons to their client.
- **Full financial disclosure:** Both parties must completely and honestly list all assets, debts, and income.
- **No duress or coercion:** The contract must be entered into voluntarily, without pressure, fraud, or unconscionable conduct.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX7KdVu1EyC2Dz21fdY9Mxx-zUCOUE_TnVcGwPpimJrG3o9P7FtPULDL_fBGJ-PQNa8qa-9UGab7Z8FCdNb7TAsEtViL-gUwW9KuoHy-5lqiEir2GwtWT3gDJKmLeATUq0QY4o7zzrRw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXVFLXeM-0G70U4XUC1JVxim7ADTWqjAZOM3q2XYnkaBgd6d6JD2X0Lhfoh7LZRSVCsLrY6JOzT4dLFfRzHRuM5cYdguv69hkrKqXNyWujpABojl1K9CgxMid5APcQaiov72ynjmH4EmeTUe8yydTpLsmDgA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXtdutfKH9zLrzdxPvdYXPQsJ1lJ_xUQnlr2GhwugI0TFaKS8lpB6N31FEklndHazvI9XhvoEutsi_gmIBKXlnFO2R7hwKDEs5fYzKSVIjmBYYpIKmDixQN5HFmq-hwcg32GlODA-lAIzu2f6-JZjHxTXE)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXtHWPoIL1uNX07rqyS4lH73VuSkzo_GrxkQRXxILZHzduU48fAavCj9ILslnJjdccL5wiZgQpYOwX0xEQRwpJ2LsemJwdMRIh-GId3oU2aaLHyUuM5Oor7inCKN9egrrek1zp-iRlE-BNVdZeSpzqxw)



---

### Why Couples Get Them

- **Blended families:** Protecting assets and inheritances so they pass down to children from a previous relationship.
- **Unequal wealth or debt:** Safeguarding a business or large savings built up before the marriage.
- **Reducing conflict:** Establishing clear financial expectations early to prevent long, expensive court battles if separation occurs.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXtHWPoIL1uNX07rqyS4lH73VuSkzo_GrxkQRXxILZHzduU48fAavCj9ILslnJjdccL5wiZgQpYOwX0xEQRwpJ2LsemJwdMRIh-GId3oU2aaLHyUuM5Oor7inCKN9egrrek1zp-iRlE-BNVdZeSpzqxw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXX8Dcvnrzkzi3I8h0rBOATpTk5nEgxQFqjvBiBrBQ25FTElitt1t2G_SVWjWbWPMDnVNunLIKuj1qOX8E2LpGzbCmuI5v_NmcKLJA6Rs2rIai5lTnBzX9W7u0mXA3PMOSCZ79bcvvz_f5EoJaC1Ltf1sNZnLMVfA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXVFLXeM-0G70U4XUC1JVxim7ADTWqjAZOM3q2XYnkaBgd6d6JD2X0Lhfoh7LZRSVCsLrY6JOzT4dLFfRzHRuM5cYdguv69hkrKqXNyWujpABojl1K9CgxMid5APcQaiov72ynjmH4EmeTUe8yydTpLsmDgA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXX-9qa7k7q1DptkYg_lGg50yPOEsvvmFMFhWeDXHbqQTR4wMp0yV3T3qUZVRsossCEtw5cBrXiGD0mlpWv3g3jsvtElKwjDuZAkoCUN2m2WIq0Mp2P2qNDbZf20HKXy2Ewy1Ktnufu4pNWnL41h1DXqZs0VeVbKQ)

You can read more about local family law rules via [Nolan Family Law](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXVFLXeM-0G70U4XUC1JVxim7ADTWqjAZOM3q2XYnkaBgd6d6JD2X0Lhfoh7LZRSVCsLrY6JOzT4dLFfRzHRuM5cYdguv69hkrKqXNyWujpABojl1K9CgxMid5APcQaiov72ynjmH4EmeTUe8yydTpLsmDgA) or [Adams United Lawyers](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXX8Dcvnrzkzi3I8h0rBOATpTk5nEgxQFqjvBiBrBQ25FTElitt1t2G_SVWjWbWPMDnVNunLIKuj1qOX8E2LpGzbCmuI5v_NmcKLJA6Rs2rIai5lTnBzX9W7u0mXA3PMOSCZ79bcvvz_f5EoJaC1Ltf1sNZnLMVfA).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXX8Dcvnrzkzi3I8h0rBOATpTk5nEgxQFqjvBiBrBQ25FTElitt1t2G_SVWjWbWPMDnVNunLIKuj1qOX8E2LpGzbCmuI5v_NmcKLJA6Rs2rIai5lTnBzX9W7u0mXA3PMOSCZ79bcvvz_f5EoJaC1Ltf1sNZnLMVfA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXVFLXeM-0G70U4XUC1JVxim7ADTWqjAZOM3q2XYnkaBgd6d6JD2X0Lhfoh7LZRSVCsLrY6JOzT4dLFfRzHRuM5cYdguv69hkrKqXNyWujpABojl1K9CgxMid5APcQaiov72ynjmH4EmeTUe8yydTpLsmDgA)Are you looking to draft an agreement for an upcoming **marriage** or a **de facto relationship** , or do you have a specific asset (like a **business** or **property** ) you want to protect?
